newsitem.title: EU: Official Journal contents - OJ C 215 of July 16, 1997.
newsitem.headline: Official Journal contents - OJ C 215 of July 16, 1997.

text.p: (Note - contents are displayed in reverse order to that in the printed Journal)
Resolution of the Commitee of the Regions on the 'Charter of the European Regions for the Environment (the Valencia Charter)' (97/C 215/10)
Opinion of the Committee of the Regions on 'The immediate measures which need to be taken to counter the damage caused by cormorants in the European regions' (97/C 215/09)
Opinion of the Committee of the Regions on the 'Green Paper on future noise policy' (97/C 215/08)
Opinion of the Committee of the Regions on:
- the 'Green Paper on the protection of minors and human dignity in audiovisual and information services', and
- the 'Communication of the Commission on Illegal and harmful content on the Internet' (97/C 215/07)
Opinion of the Committee of the Regions on the 'Report from the European Commission on "Young farmers and the problem of succession in European agriculture"' (97/C 215/06)
Opinion of the Committee of the Regions on the '6th and 7th annual report on the Structural Funds - 1994 and 1995' (97/C 215/05)
Opinion of the Committee of the Regions on 'Intercultural education' (97/C 215/04)
Opinion of the Committee of the Regions on 'New economic activities and new services in rural areas' (97/C 215/03)
Opinion of the Committee of the Regions on 'Regional nature parks: examples for the sustainable development of the most sensitive areas of the EU' (97/C 215/02)
Opinion of the Committee of the Regions on the 'European Commission Green Paper on Education - Training - Research: The obstacles to transnational Mobility' (97/C 215/01) END OF DOCUMENT.
